title: Mum's daily calls and feeling like a bad son

assumptions.premise: Supporting your mother properly requires being available to her every single day.
assumptions.probe: What does it actually mean to "be there for her"?

assumptions.premise: Dreading these calls or struggling with them makes you a failing son.
assumptions.probe: Who decided that dreading a call makes someone a "bad son"?

assumptions.premise: Because she is on her own, her loneliness is yours alone to fix.
assumptions.probe: How much of her being "on her own" is possible for one person to carry?

assumptions.premise: Your only choices are enduring the daily drain or cutting her off completely.
assumptions.probe: What lives between having to "keep doing this" and choosing to "stop"?
